oracle_discipline: RAW prompts only (prompt_hash is sha256 of the raw prompt bytes, never a template-rendered prompt); CPU teacher-forcing rank + logit gap; CPU engine vs CPU comparator only; comparator artifacts are a verdict class.
rule: Every matrix row records model sha256, oracle backend, oracle build hash, prompt hash. A row without pins cannot be marked judged; mark_judged in aesir_engine/core/oracle_pins.mojo is the enforcement point and raises, naming every missing or malformed pin.
